description: Typed asset discovery, verified downloads, safe extraction and curated promotion from itch.io, Poly Haven and a local SQLite catalog.
rules: Require an explicit asset root or ASSET_FETCH_ASSETS_ROOT for catalog searches.
Validate lexical containment and existing symlink ancestors before writes.
Audit extracted trees before committing them and reject dangling or escaping links.
Promotion is dry-run unless apply is explicitly true.
Keep ESM and CommonJS exports and declarations equivalent.
